Grain assisted recombination. Rate from WD01.
WD01 quote an accuracy of 20% for 10 < T < 10^3 K, 10^2 < phi < 10^6
[where phi = G0 * sqrt(T) / ne]
The WD01 fitting formula is:
alpha_g = 1e-14 * C0 * (1 + C1 * phi^C2 * (1 + C3 * T^C4 * phi *
(- C5 - C6 ln T)))^-1
We tabulate (C3*T^C4) and (- C5 - C6 ln T) for each ion of interest
(currently HII, HeII, CII, SiII). The other portions of the fit need to be
computed on the fly in the chemistry routine, as they depend on the
electron density.
